How to load Pride Board Textures?
[b]Android users[/b]
1.  Download the file "[b][CP] Pride Board Textures[/b]".
2.  Must download [b]Zarchiver [/b]or any types of [b]Zip [/b]/ [b]7z Extractor[/b].
3.  Click Extract to get the files
4.  Paste the Mod file into the Mods folder “[b]Stardewvalley[/b][b]”[/b].
5.  Click your [b]SMAPI [/b]Installer and launch the app to load the CPPBT mod. Enjoy.. ^_^
[b] [/b]
[b]Windows users[/b]
1.  Download the file"[b][CP] Pride Board Textures][/b]".
2.  Must download Winrar or any types of [b]Zip [/b]/ [b]7z Extractor[/b].
3.  Click Extract to get the files
4.  Copy and pastethe mod file into your “[b]Stardew Valley[/b][b]”[/b]folder.
5.  Click your [b]SMAPI [/b]exe to load the CPPBT mod. Enjoy.. ^_^
 
[b]Reminder: I (Pokegirl Gamer) is the owner of these assets, I made a retexture for the Skateboard mod and thankfully it does matched. Please do not use them without my consent. Glitches or Errors? Please report all of the
